subject: Seed strategy + vector store decisioning and rerank calibration for BrightPath
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Shaw <devon@brightpath.io>, Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@brightpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Seed strategy + vector store decisioning and rerank calibration for BrightPath

Hi Devon / Aisha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I put together an initial practical plan for the embedding index seeding and the downstream reranker calibration so your search relevancy goals are met without a long outage window. Attached: bp_index_seed_plan_v1.xlsx (high-level schedule + sample queries) and a tiny rerank sample (rerank_eval_sample.jsonl).

High-level approach (proposed):
- Seed priority 1: critical product pages (approx 120k records) with dense embeddings + metadata.
- Seed priority 2: supplemental docs (500k records) in batched backfills over 2 weeks; use continuous batching and small-window TTL to reduce cold-start token costs.
- Vector store: evaluate Milvus (self-host) vs Redwood-managed Pinecone cluster topology. For BrightPath I recommend starting on Redwood-managed store to speed time-to-value, then consider a Dedicated Milvus for predictable cost after Q2.
- Rerank: shadow-run candidate reranker on 2% of traffic using your current scorer -> compare MRR / Precision@5 / latency. Target: +8–12% MRR improvement with <40ms added tail p95 on the query path.

Open questions for you:
1) Are there strict blackout windows for seeding (e.g., weekend-only)?
2) Any doc retention or PII filters we should apply before embedding?
3) Who on your infra team will own vector DB credentials / VPC peering?

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa will own the implementation checklist and coordinate preflight (schema mapping, sample exports) — action: Marissa to send a preflight form by Wed 24th.
2) Karthik will scope rerank eval harness and suggest thresholds — action: Karthik to deliver an eval plan and sample job by Thu 25th.
3) Devon / Aisha to confirm blackout windows and provide sample dataset slice (CSV export or S3 path) by EOD Tue 23rd.

If that sounds good I can schedule a 30-min alignment next week to lock the schedule.

Thanks,
Sean
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bp_index_seed_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), rerank_eval_sample.jsonl (3k lines sample)
From: Devon Shaw <devon@brightpath.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Seed strategy + vector store decisioning and rerank calibration for BrightPath

Thanks Sean — this is great and captures our constraints. Quick answers: 1) We prefer rolling seeding during off-peak windows (US/Eastern nights) but not strictly weekend-only; 2) We need to strip user emails and account ids before embedding (PII policy); 3) I'll loop in infra (cc'ed Aisha) — she owns VPC peering.

I'll send a small CSV of 3k rows with titles + body + metadata to the S3 path you shared by EOD today.

Devon
VP Product
BrightPath Analytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Shaw <devon@brightpath.io>, Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@brightpath.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Seed strategy + vector store decisioning and rerank calibration for BrightPath

Adding a little more implementation detail from the ops side so the team has concrete checkpoints.

Preflight checklist (I'll send a form but capturing here):
- Data schema mapping: confirm id/title/body/tags fields and target embedding column.
- PII filters: we will run Redwood scrub pipeline (email/account redaction) as a pre-ingest job; Devon please confirm any extra regexes.
- Sampling: suggest a 10k random sample + 500 targeted 'top queries' sample for rerank GOLD set.
- Backfill cadence: 50k records/night (off-peak) for the supplemental set; monitor ingestion error rate <0.5%.
- Rollout windows: dark-launch rerank against 2% traffic for one week, then 10% for 3 days before full promotion.

Vector store decision guidance (ops notes):
- Redwood-managed vector store (Pinecone topology): pros = faster onboarding, automatic replication, support SLA; cons = less control over compaction/replicas.
- Milvus self-host (Dedicated): pros = predictable unit cost at scale, more control over index types (IVF/PQ/HNSW); cons = infra ownership & operational runbook for compaction and backups.

I recommend we begin on Redwood-managed for the seeding + initial eval (reduce ops friction) and plan a cost-swap to Dedicated Milvus after the first month if qps steadily > 150 rps or cost projection crosses threshold.

Action items (owners / due):
- Marissa: send preflight form + template mapping (Wed 24th EOD) — DONE (form link in Drive).
- Karthik: rerank eval harness + baseline metrics (Thu 25th COB).
- Monica: provide monitoring dashboard template & PRs for alerts (Fri 26th).

I'll coordinate a 30-min cutover alignment for Thu 25th @ 10am PT — please confirm availability.

-Marissa
Senior Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: index_seed_backfill_cadence.md (short note)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Shaw <devon@brightpath.io>, Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@brightpath.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 07:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Seed strategy + vector store decisioning and rerank calibration for BrightPath

Quick thread update with the rerank evaluation plan (summary):

Eval goals / scope:
- Compare baseline BrightPath scorer vs. Redwood candidate reranker across 3K annotated queries. Metrics: MRR, Precision@5, NDCG@10; latency (p50/p95).
- Accept threshold: candidate must show >= +0.08 absolute MRR lift OR >= +10% relative improvement on Precision@5 with p95 added latency < 40ms.

Data & tooling:
- Gold set: 500 targeted queries (high-importance), 2.5k random queries for distributional coverage. We'll use your sample + additional synthetics to stress long-tail.
- Eval harness: will run as batch jobs in Redwood infra writing to S3; summary CSV / interactive notebook will be provided.

Smoke tests before dark-launch:
- Sanity: top-10 candidate overlap >60% with baseline (detect major drift).
- Quality gating: if baseline precision drops >5% in shadow traffic, automatic rollback.

Deliverables (dates):
- Eval harness + instructions: Thu 25 Mar 2027 17:00 PT.
- Initial rerank results (first 3k sample): Mon 29 Mar 2027 EOD.

I'll attach the eval job config in the shared Drive. If we meet the threshold we'll promote to 2% traffic shadow for one week.

-karthik
Applied ML Engineer
Redwood Inference
